chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 96: Agony – Li Huowang Hits Rock Bottom
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang can no longer tell reality from illusion. When a sniper’s bullet sends him reeling into the bamboo grove, his only escape is to weaponize his own unbearable pain through the Thousand Greats Record.
og_title: Agony – The Record Roots in Blood
og_description: Li Huowang almost kills a child, watches his mother kneel, and takes a sniper round—all before realizing that his anguish is the only fuel left for the Thousand Greats Record.
twitter_title: Li Huowang Can’t Tell Reality—And That’s His Weapon
twitter_description: A sniper, a mother’s plea, and a bamboo grove full of voices. Li Huowang hits absolute despair—and the Thousand Greats Record begins to root in his blood.
